# Build twin db documents (plan frames, plan index, board) and a batch manifest.
import json, os, re, sys, time
sp = sys.argv[1]; b = os.path.join(sp, "board"); out = os.path.join(sp, "dbwrite"); os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
now = int(time.time() * 1000)
APPROVALS = {"pending", "approved", "rejected", "changes_requested"}
index, writes = [], []
for f in sorted(os.listdir(os.path.join(b, "slices"))):
    try: j = json.load(open(os.path.join(b, "slices", f)))
    except Exception: continue
    pid = j["plan_id"]
    slices = [{"num": s["num"], "title": s.get("title", ""), "approval": s.get("approval_status") if s.get("approval_status") in APPROVALS else "pending",
               "complexity": s.get("complexity") or "", "effort": s.get("effort") or "", "risk": s.get("risk") or ""} for s in j.get("slices") or []]
    counts = {k: sum(1 for s in slices if s["approval"] == k) for k in APPROVALS}; counts["total"] = len(slices)
    index.append({"id": pid, "title": j.get("title", ""), "status": j.get("status", ""), "counts": counts})
    doc = {"planId": pid, "title": j.get("title", ""), "status": j.get("status", ""), "slices": slices, "writtenAt": now}
    if pid == "plan-0f48cf00":
        doc["seq"] = 6; writes.append({"op": "update", "collection": "plans", "doc_id": pid, "if_version": 5})
    else:
        doc["seq"] = 1; writes.append({"op": "set", "collection": "plans", "doc_id": pid})
    p = os.path.join(out, pid + ".json"); json.dump(doc, open(p, "w")); writes[-1]["file_path"] = p
order = {"draft": 0, "active": 1, "finalized": 2}
index.sort(key=lambda p: (order.get(p["status"], 3), p["id"]))
json.dump({"plans": index, "writtenAt": now}, open(os.path.join(out, "planindex.json"), "w"))
writes.append({"op": "set", "collection": "planindex", "doc_id": "current", "file_path": os.path.join(out, "planindex.json")})
def col(name):
    d = json.load(open(os.path.join(b, name + ".json")))
    items = [{"id": i["id"], "type": i["type"], "title": i.get("title", ""), "priority": i.get("priority", ""),
              "updatedAt": i.get("updated_at", ""), "claimed": bool(i.get("open_claim_holders"))} for i in d["items"]]
    return {"items": items, "matched": d["items_matched"]}
totals = []
for line in open(os.path.join(b, "snapshot.txt")):
    m = re.match(r"\s*(features|bugs|spikes|tracks)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", line)
    if m: totals.append({"label": m[1].capitalize(), "total": int(m[2]), "inProgress": int(m[3]), "blocked": int(m[4]), "done": int(m[5])})
board = {"columns": {"in_progress": col("ip"), "todo": col("todo"), "done": col("done")}, "totals": totals,
         "total": sum(t["total"] for t in totals), "writtenAt": now}
json.dump(board, open(os.path.join(out, "board.json"), "w"))
writes.append({"op": "set", "collection": "board", "doc_id": "current", "file_path": os.path.join(out, "board.json")})
json.dump(writes, open(os.path.join(out, "writes.json"), "w"), indent=0)
print(len(writes), "writes;", "board", os.path.getsize(os.path.join(out, "board.json")), "B; index", os.path.getsize(os.path.join(out, "planindex.json")), "B")
print(totals)
EOF

# Build twin db documents (plan frames with slice details, plan index, board) and a batch manifest.
# Usage: build_data.py <scratchpad> <versions.json: {"collection/doc": version}>
import json, os, re, sys, time
sp = sys.argv[1]; versions = json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
b = os.path.join(sp, "board"); out = os.path.join(sp, "dbwrite"); os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
now = int(time.time() * 1000)
APPROVALS = ("pending", "approved", "rejected", "changes_requested")
DETAILS = ("what", "why", "files", "deps", "done_when")
writes = []
def write(collection, doc_id, doc):
    p = os.path.join(out, f"{collection}-{doc_id}.json"); json.dump(doc, open(p, "w"))
    v = versions.get(f"{collection}/{doc_id}")
    w = {"op": "update" if v else "set", "collection": collection, "doc_id": doc_id, "file_path": p}
    if v: w["if_version"] = v
    writes.append(w)
lists = {t: json.load(open(os.path.join(b, "lists", t + ".json"))) for t in ("feature", "bug", "spike", "track", "plan")}
status_of = {i["id"]: i["status"] for t in lists.values() for i in t}
index = []
for f in sorted(os.listdir(os.path.join(b, "slices2"))):
    j = json.load(open(os.path.join(b, "slices2", f))); pid = j["plan_id"]
    slices = []
    for s in j.get("slices") or []:
        row = {"num": s["num"], "title": s.get("title", ""), "approval": s.get("approval_status") if s.get("approval_status") in APPROVALS else "pending",
               "complexity": s.get("complexity") or "", "effort": s.get("effort") or "", "risk": s.get("risk") or "",
               "featureId": s.get("feature_id") or "", "featureStatus": status_of.get(s.get("feature_id") or "", "")}
        for k in DETAILS:
            if s.get(k): row[k] = s[k]
        slices.append(row)
    counts = {k: sum(1 for s in slices if s["approval"] == k) for k in APPROVALS}; counts["total"] = len(slices)
    index.append({"id": pid, "title": j.get("title", ""), "status": j.get("status", ""), "counts": counts, "legacy": j.get("source") == "html"})
    seq = 7 if pid == "plan-0f48cf00" else 2
    write("plans", pid, {"planId": pid, "title": j.get("title", ""), "status": j.get("status", ""), "slices": slices, "seq": seq, "writtenAt": now})
order = {"draft": 0, "active": 1, "finalized": 2}
index.sort(key=lambda p: (order.get(p["status"], 3), p["id"]))
write("planindex", "current", {"plans": index, "writtenAt": now})
claimed = {i["id"] for i in json.load(open(os.path.join(b, "ip.json")))["items"] if i.get("open_claim_holders")}
items = [i for t in ("feature", "bug", "spike", "track") for i in lists[t]]
def col(status, limit):
    rows = sorted((i for i in items if i["status"] == status), key=lambda i: i["updated_at"], reverse=True)
    pick = rows if limit is None else rows[:limit]
    return {"items": [{"id": i["id"], "type": i["type"], "title": i["title"], "priority": i["priority"], "updatedAt": i["updated_at"],
                       "claimed": i["id"] in claimed, "trackId": i.get("track_id", "")} for i in pick], "matched": len(rows)}
totals = []
for line in open(os.path.join(b, "snapshot.txt")):
    m = re.match(r"\s*(features|bugs|spikes|tracks)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", line)
    if m: totals.append({"label": m[1].capitalize(), "total": int(m[2]), "inProgress": int(m[3]), "blocked": int(m[4]), "done": int(m[5])})
write("board", "current", {"columns": {"in_progress": col("in-progress", None), "todo": col("todo", 40), "done": col("done", 20)},
                           "totals": totals, "total": sum(t["total"] for t in totals), "writtenAt": now})
json.dump(writes, open(os.path.join(out, "writes.json"), "w"))
sizes = sorted(((os.path.getsize(w["file_path"]), w["doc_id"]) for w in writes), reverse=True)[:3]
print(len(writes), "writes; largest", sizes)
EOF

find $R/internal $R/plan $R/observe $R/recap $R/port -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" -print0 | xargs -0 grep -HnoE "^func [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*\(|^type [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]* |^(var|const) [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]* " | while IFS=: read f ln m; do
  name=$(echo "$m" | sed -E "s/^(func|type|var|const) //; s/[ (]$//")
  d=$(dirname $f); pkg=$(basename $d)
  same=$(grep -nw "$name" $d/*.go 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go:" | grep -v "^$f:$ln:" | grep -vE "^[^:]+:[0-9]+:\s*//" | wc -l)

  tmpl=$(grep -rlw "$name" --include="*.gohtml" --include="*.tmpl" --include="*.html" $d 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  [ "$same" = 0 ] && [ "$other" = 0 ] && [ "$tmpl" = 0 ] && echo "${f#$R/}:$ln $name"
done' 2>&1 | sort
